description: This file defines common data structures, enums, and constants related to session server management in the Rialto project, including session server states, resource capabilities, application configuration, socket permissions, and server manager configuration.

classes.name: MaxResourceCapabilitites
classes.description: Represents the maximum resource capabilities of the platform, including maximum playbacks and web audio players.

classes.name: AppConfig
classes.description: Holds configuration data for an application, including socket names for IPC and display.

classes.name: SocketPermissions
classes.description: Defines permissions for session management sockets, including owner, group, and others.

classes.name: ServerManagerConfig
classes.description: Contains configuration data for the server manager, such as environment variables, number of preloaded servers, server path, startup timeout, health check interval, and socket permissions.
